killedBy: live status announcements (issue #629) does NOT announce a life loss from a lives drop with no death behind it
why: Derives a life loss from lives going DOWN, which is the obvious implementation and the wrong one. `pushStatus` fires on every world build, not only on a death -- a level advance carrying fewer lives, a quit-to-title, issue #252's Restart with Same Seed -- so a session replaced by a board that starts lower is narrated as a death that did not happen. `signalPlayerDeath` is the authoritative event and `loop.ts` already fires it on a real one; this entry is why the announcement waits for it.
